## How to update in DO n8n safely

How to Safely Update n8n on Digital Ocean with Docker Compose
Prerequisites Check

Ensure you have a Docker Compose setup (check for docker-compose.yml file)
Use docker compose (with space) not docker-compose (with hyphen) for modern Docker installations

Step-by-Step Update Process
1. Navigate to your n8n directory
bashcd /path/to/your/n8n-directory
# Example: cd /home/kacper/n8n-docker-caddy
2. Create a backup (recommended)
bashmkdir -p ~/n8n-backup
docker run --rm -v n8n_data:/source -v ~/n8n-backup:/backup alpine tar czf /backup/n8n-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz -C /source .
3. Update the containers
bash# Pull latest images
docker compose pull

# Restart with new versions
docker compose up -d
4. Monitor the update
bash# Check container status
docker compose ps

# Watch startup logs
docker compose logs -f n8n
5. Verify the update
bash# Check version
docker compose exec n8n n8n --version

# Test accessibility (replace with your domain)
curl -I https://your-domain.com
What Gets Preserved Automatically

✅ All workflows and automations
✅ User accounts and credentials (encrypted)
✅ Execution history
✅ All configurations and settings
✅ SSL certificates (via Caddy)

Safety Notes

Data is stored in Docker volumes - these persist across container updates
Always backup before major updates - though data loss is extremely rare
Monitor logs during startup - database migrations may run automatically
Your n8n stays accessible - minimal downtime during the update

Common Issues & Solutions

Port conflicts: Stop existing containers first with docker compose down
Permission warnings: These are informational and don't affect functionality
Migration messages: These are normal during updates - let them complete
Deprecated warnings: Update your docker-compose.yml file as suggested

This process typically takes 2-5 minutes and ensures zero data loss while getting the latest n8n features and security updates.
